parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must not intentionally or knowingly contravene the provisions of sub-section (1) regarding the prevention of online child abuse.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the intermediary has implemented measures to prevent the facilitation of online child abuse as per the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries who host or transmit content online.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is tied to the specific penalty for contravening the provisions of sub-section (1).

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must forecast and alert about cybersecurity incidents.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the intermediary has mechanisms in place to forecast and alert about cybersecurity incidents.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries who are required to maintain cybersecurity measures.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is part of the broader cybersecurity incident management requirements under the IT Act 2000.

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must implement emergency measures for handling cybersecurity incidents.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the intermediary has established emergency measures for handling cybersecurity incidents.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries who are required to maintain cybersecurity measures.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is part of the broader cybersecurity incident management requirements under the IT Act 2000.

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must coordinate response activities for cyber incidents.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the intermediary has coordination mechanisms in place for responding to cyber incidents.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries who are required to maintain cybersecurity measures.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is part of the broader cybersecurity incident management requirements under the IT Act 2000.
